system:
You draft public warning messages for a national alerting authority.
You receive event inputs (each marked verified or unverified) and the issuing context.
Write one alert in English as CAP 1.2 fields.

- Use only facts present in the verified inputs. Do not add places, numbers, times or hazards that are not there.
- Leave unverified inputs out of the alert, and say why in `left_out`.
- `description` is the text shown on the phone by cell broadcast: plain words, under 280 characters, hazard + where + until when, if known.
- `instruction` is the protective action in one or two short sentences.
- Pick CAP values honestly: status from the context (Actual for a real event, Exercise for a drill), severity and urgency from the inputs.
- `note_for_reviewer` is one or two sentences for the human approver: what you were unsure about.
user:
Issuer: Demo national authority (stands in for the real issuer)
Context: EXERCISE / DRILL
Target area (chosen by the operator): Coastal and inland areas, Abu Dhabi (demo zone)

Event inputs:
1. [verified; NCM via WAM, 2026-02-16, https://www.wam.ae/en/article/byrq247-national-centre-meteorology-warns-dust-reduced] ABU DHABI, 16th February, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) warned today of active to occasionally strong northwesterly winds, raising dust and sand and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 3,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. The Centre stated in a statement issued today that the weather conditions began at 10:30 and will continue until 18:00, urging the public to exercise caution, particularly when driving on external and open roads, due to the risk of sudden drops in visibility caused by blowing dust.
2. [verified; issuer profile] Issuer public site (demo): https://alerts.example.ae
3. [verified; institution reviewers] Objections from the institution reviewers to your previous draft. Fix what is within the verified inputs; do not add facts: Met office reviewer objects (headline): The alert places the hazard in 'coastal and inland Abu Dhabi'. The verified NCM bulletin names no emirate and refers only to 'some coastal and inland areas'. 'ABU DHABI' in the input is the WAM dateline, not the warning area. The alert therefore changes the places covered, and people in other affected areas may wrongly think the warning does not apply to them. Fix: Remove 'Abu Dhabi' from the headline and description and use the bulletin's wording, for example 'Blowing dust reducing visibility in some coastal and inland areas of the UAE until 18:00' and '...reducing visibility to under 3,000 m in some coastal and inland areas.' Do not name a specific emirate unless NCM specifies one. | Network operator and regulator reviewer objects (phone_text): No protective action appears anywhere in either language, so the first page cannot carry the action. Both texts only describe the wind, dust and visibility, plus the end time and source. In Arabic, the first 41-character page holds only the exercise tag and 'strong northwesterly winds'; the dust and visibility hazard spills onto page 2. Fix: Add a short protective action right after the hazard in both languages, and put both at the very start. For example, EN: 'EXERCISE - Dust storm, visibility under 3 km, Abu Dhabi coast/inland: drive slowly, keep distance, avoid outdoor activity if you have breathing problems.' Give the matching Arabic wording, front-loaded so that 'غبار' (dust) and the action begin on page 1. Move the wind detail, end time and source after the action. [cites Wireless Emergency Alerts; Amendments to Part 11, Report and Order (DA 25-12), multilingual WEA templates, p.21]

data.headline: EXERCISE: Blowing dust reducing visibility in some coastal and inland areas until 18:00
data.description: EXERCISE - Blowing dust: visibility under 3,000 m in some coastal and inland areas. Drive with caution on external and open roads; visibility can drop suddenly. Northwesterly winds, occasionally strong, until 18:00 today, 16 Feb. Source: NCM.
data.instruction: Take extra care when driving, especially on external and open roads, because blowing dust can suddenly reduce visibility. Updates: https://alerts.example.ae
left_out: 'Abu Dhabi' as the hazard location: it is the WAM dateline, not the warning area. The NCM bulletin names only 'some coastal and inland areas'.
'of the UAE' from the Met reviewer's example: the bulletin does not state the country or any emirate, so it was not added.

'Drive slowly, keep distance' and 'avoid outdoor activity if you have breathing problems' from the network reviewer's example: the verified bulletin only urges caution when driving on external and open roads. Health advice is not in the inputs.
Arabic phone text: this draft is English only, as instructed. The Arabic version, front-loaded with 'غبار' and the driving action on page 1, needs a separate translation.
Start time 10:30: dropped from the phone text for length. The hazard is already in progress.
data.note_for_reviewer: The operator's target area is the Abu Dhabi demo zone, but the bulletin does not name an emirate, so the text uses the bulletin's 'some coastal and inland areas' wording; please confirm this suits the chosen polygon. I used only NCM's driving caution as the action and did not add the reviewers' extra health and driving advice, because it is not in the verified bulletin.
